segments.text:
V. 15.
John cried—With Joy and Confidence: This is he of whom I ſa•d—J•••
had ſaid this, before our LORD's Paptiſm, altho' he then knew Him not in Perſon, He knew Him firſt at his Baptiſm, and afterwards cried. This is he of whom I ſaid, &c. He is preferred before me—In his Office: for He was before me—In his Nature.
